`archimate.excalidraw` holds the elements of "Excalidraw Archimate Template" by Timothy Galvin
(`timothygalvin/excalidraw-archimate-template.excalidrawlib` in
[excalidraw-libraries](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw-libraries), MIT, © Excalidraw),
made by excalidraw.com and wrapped as a scene. The tests read it as a real excalidraw.com file.
